name: ux-product-design-workflow
description: Autonomous 7-phase UX & Product Design workflow with self-loading context, 200+ mapped skills, command workflow chains, and Impeccable Standard self-audit. Covers Discovery, Define, IA, Prototyping, Validation, Handoff, and Optimization with 6 autonomous agents, full Skill tool access to 1000+ skills, spec-kit integration, Figma MCP, 24 templates, 7 DoD checklists, non-linear iteration with loop-back triggers, agent coordination rules, evidence tagging, and MCP integrations for accessibility, browser automation, design systems, analytics, and prototype review.

accesslint.description: WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility auditing for URLs, files, and HTML

playwright.description: Browser automation for prototype testing, interaction flows, and visual regression

chrome-devtools.description: Performance auditing, Lighthouse, CWV measurement, network analysis

Claude_Preview.description: Live preview of HTML/React prototypes with interactive testing

shadcn-ui.description: shadcn/ui component registry lookup and design system alignment

shadcn-community.description: Community component discovery, themes, and page-level patterns

storybook-figma.description: Design-to-code bridging via Storybook stories and Figma integration

context7.description: Up-to-date library documentation lookup for any framework

agents.name: ux-accessibility-auditor
agents.description: WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility auditor. Audits URLs, files, and HTML using AccessLint MCP. Trigger after prototype review or before handoff.

agents.name: ux-artifact-generator
agents.description: Transforms raw research data into structured UX artifacts: personas, journey maps, empathy maps, problem statements, HMW, JTBD, opportunity solution trees.

agents.name: ux-handoff-preparer
agents.description: Generates the full design-to-engineering handoff package: acceptance criteria (Gherkin), edge case catalogs, state specs, accessibility specs, shadcn component cross-references.

agents.name: ux-phase-navigator
agents.description: Detects current UX phase, checks Definition of Done criteria, gates phase transitions, and maintains phase-status.json. Invoke when starting or checking progress.

agents.name: ux-prototype-reviewer
agents.description: Reviews live prototypes and dev servers. Applies Nielsen's 10 heuristics, validates interaction states, captures screenshots. Uses Claude Preview, Playwright, and Chrome DevTools MCPs.

agents.name: ux-researcher
agents.description: Autonomous UX researcher for competitive analysis, UX teardowns, and accessibility scanning. Browses live URLs and documents findings using browser MCPs.

skills.name: ux-product-design-workflow
skills.description: Master orchestrator skill for the full 7-phase UX workflow. Routes to phase-specific sub-skills based on context.

skills.name: ux-discover
skills.description: Phase 1: Discovery & Research — stakeholder alignment, interview guides, competitive analysis, JTBD mapping, empathy mapping.

skills.name: ux-define
skills.description: Phase 2: Define & Problem Framing — affinity mapping, persona creation, journey mapping, problem statements, HMW statements, Opportunity Solution Trees.

skills.name: ux-ia
skills.description: Phase 3: IA & Interaction Design — information architecture, sitemaps, user flows, state inventories, wireframe descriptions.

skills.name: ux-prototype
skills.description: Phase 4: Prototyping & Laws of UX — high-fidelity prototypes, design system integration, Laws of UX application, RTL/MENA patterns.

skills.name: ux-validate
skills.description: Phase 5: Validation & Usability Testing — test planning, participant recruitment, think-aloud protocol, heuristic evaluation, WCAG audit, findings synthesis.

skills.name: ux-handoff
skills.description: Phase 6: Design-to-Engineering Handoff — annotated specs, state documentation, edge case catalogs, accessibility requirements, acceptance criteria.

skills.name: ux-optimize
skills.description: Phase 7: Post-Launch Optimization — HEART framework, AARRR metrics, Goals-Signals-Metrics, A/B experiment design, Product Kata cycles, continuous discovery.
